يحتقروا (form VIII)
# يَحْتَقِرُوا (yaḥtaqirū) /jaħ.ta.qi.ruː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَقَرَ (iḥtaqara)
# يُحْتَقَرُوا (yuḥtaqarū) /juħ.ta.qa.ruː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَقَرَ (iḥtaqara)
